name: Slate (layout)
_comment: A LAYOUT as data -- the file half of task 036.4, shaped exactly like the bundled `theme` addon's own
theme.json and naming this suite's probe windows instead of the client's, so the assertions are numbers
rather than a look. Each key is a selector that names a WIDGET (a site key cannot carry layout: a site is
where the client draws text, and text has no position), and each rule says where that widget goes.
`anchor` is a relationship: a corner of the screen (or of another widget), plus an offset in raw pixels.
`pos` is the same property said as an absolute point, and `size` is the widget's CONTENT box; both take the
[x, y] array a colour and a 9-slice's insets already take.
NOTHING HERE IS MAPPED. The chrome half of a theme needs three lines of Lua because an image and a font's
face are HANDLES; a corner, an offset and a point are not, so the table hafen.json.parse returns IS the
sheet -- which is what this suite asserts by handing it to hafen.ui.skin{} unchanged.
